about: The golden set (docs/dev/SCENE_ENGINE_V2.md 22): reference scenes and objects that calibrate the sanity and composition thresholds and the critic. Builder G proposes the candidates; ONLY the user sets approved to true. Tools: scene golden list | sheet | measure | calibrate; scene compare-to-golden <ref>.

entries.why: the evening: low sun, long light through the birches
winter water: the bare trees mirrored, a cold clear sky
a village green in spring: blossom, scale of people against the church
open water with a believable far bank and reflections
autumn colour that stays readable, calm water
the faceless figure at every size
the reference tree: crown, trunk and seasons
a vehicle with front and rear views (vehicle.car-front, vehicle.car-rear)
the canal boat, with bow and stern views
a generated Victorian terrace (builder F's generator; measured once it lands)
a landmark: real height, clean silhouette, night glow

pending: the 3 showcase scenes of V2 29 (v2-demo/*), once built: they fill the urban slots (none of today’s urban scenes is clean: see notReady)
one OSM-composed street from scene compose

notReady.why: the canal is drawn as a flat band across the frame (a lake), not a channel in perspective
the station and its platform float above the field; lollipop trees float on the hillside
translucent ghost hill shapes behind the hut; the subject sits on a flat band
cluttered: a forest of lamps, benches and puddles fills the street
ghost haze domes across the keep at golden hour; a lit box behind the keep at night
translucent ghost domes and trees behind the mill
the town hall dead centre; a ghost dome over it
ghost hill blobs and heavy haze over the middle distance
the gorge walls read as hazy translucent shapes; the road is a short stub
